modules.title: Button
modules.description: A clickable action with a visual variant, optional icons, and a loading state.
modules.importLine: import { Button, type ButtonProps, type ButtonRadiusValue, type ButtonTypeValue } from '@korzun/design/control'
modules.body:
A clickable action with a visual variant, optional icons, and a loading state.
Renders a `<div role="button">` (keyboard: Enter and Space, which it
preventDefaults, so Space does not scroll the page) unless `submit` is
set, in which case it renders a native `<button type="submit">`.

Use something else for: navigating back (`BackButton`), page-level actions in
the header (`PageActionsBar`, `PageActionsMenu`), sticky footer actions
(`PageFooterActions`), picking one of several options (`SegmentedControl`).

## Usage

### Choosing a variant

- `primary`: the one main action of a card, modal, or page (Save, Confirm).
- `default`: secondary actions; bordered.
- `text`: Cancel in a modal footer.
- `link`: inline row actions (Remove, Load more). It has no padding, so `radius`
  doesn't matter for it.
- `dashed`: an "add a row" affordance (as in `FieldList`).
- Add `danger` for destructive actions (Delete, Log out), on `primary` in a
  confirm or on `default` otherwise.

### Corners

The radius follows where the button sits (16px on a page, 8px in a `Card` or
`Dialog`, 4px in a `Popover` or nested Card), so pass no `radius`; see
[corners](../corners.md). Pass it only to override.

### Submitting a form

`submit` renders a native submit button and `onClick` is then ignored: handle
the form's `action` or `onSubmit`. For a button outside its form (a `Card`
footer), pass the form's id as `form`. While the form action is pending the
button shows its spinner by itself.

## Do / don't

- Don't set `radius` to match the surface; it follows depth. Pass it only to
  override.
- Do give repeated row actions a distinguishing `ariaLabel` ("Remove Kindle").
- Don't pass `type="submit"`: it is not a valid variant. Use `submit`.
- Don't pass `onClick` to a submit button and expect it to run.
- Don't pass an element to `prefix`/`suffix` (`prefix={<SearchIcon />}`); pass
  the component.
- Don't wrap Button in a `<button>` or `<a>`: it is already interactive.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description:
One `primary` action for the main step and a `default` button beside it.
`onClick` takes no arguments: the button passes no event.

examples.title: Variants
examples.description:
`type` picks the look, not the HTML attribute. `primary` is the one main action,
`default` a secondary one, `text` a Cancel in a modal footer, `link` an inline
row action, and `dashed` an "add a row" affordance.

examples.title: Danger and success
examples.description:
Add `danger` to a destructive action: on `primary` when it confirms the
deletion, on `default` otherwise. `success` is the green treatment. The two
cannot both be set; TypeScript rejects it.

examples.title: Icons
examples.description:
`prefix` and `suffix` take an icon component (`prefix={SearchIcon}`), not an
element. An icon-only button needs an `ariaLabel` so it has an accessible name.

examples.title: Loading and disabled
examples.description:
`loading` swaps the icons for a spinner and blocks clicks; `disabled` greys the
button out. Both take the button out of the tab order.

examples.title: Submit button in a card footer
examples.description:
`submit` renders a native submit button; `form` points it at a form elsewhere
in the card. `onClick` is ignored on a submit button, so handle the form's
`action`. Inside a Card the corners step down by themselves: no `radius` prop.

examples.title: Confirm dialog footer
examples.description:
A `text` Cancel beside a `primary danger` action. `loading` shows the spinner
and blocks a second click while the deletion runs; `canDismiss={!deleting}`
keeps the dialog open until it finishes. Inside a Dialog the corners step down
by themselves: no `radius` prop.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The label.

rows.name: ariaControls
rows.description: For a disclosure button: the id of the element it controls.

rows.name: ariaExpanded
rows.description: For a disclosure button: whether the element it controls is expanded.

rows.name: ariaHasPopup
rows.description: Announces that the button opens a popup of this kind (`'menu'` for a menu trigger). Rendered in both modes.

rows.name: ariaLabel
rows.description: Accessible name when the visible children are not distinguishing enough on their own — several "Remove" buttons in a list, each belonging to a different row.

rows.name: className
rows.description: Extra class; win specificity with `'&&'` in your sheet, never `!important`.

rows.name: danger
rows.description: Red treatment for destructive actions. Mutually exclusive with `success` (setting both is a type error).

rows.name: disabled
rows.description: Greys the button out and blocks clicks.

rows.name: form
rows.description: Id of the `<form>` to submit, for a `submit` button outside its form (e.g. in a `Card` footer).

rows.name: loading
rows.description: Shows a spinner in place of the icons and blocks clicks.

rows.name: onClick
rows.description: Click and Enter/Space handler. **Ignored when `submit` is set**; the form submits instead. Receives no event. Not called while `disabled` or `loading`.

rows.name: prefix
rows.description: Icon component shown before the label (`prefix={SearchIcon}`), not an element.

rows.name: radius
rows.description: The surface the button sits on, which sets its corner radius. Unset (the default), the radius follows surface depth: 16px on a page or outside any surface, 8px in a Card or Dialog, 4px in a Popover or nested Card. Pass it only to override; see [corners](../corners.md).

rows.name: ref
rows.description: Ref to the root element (the `<div role="button">`, or the `<button>` in submit mode), e.g. to `.focus()` it. A plain prop; no `forwardRef`.

rows.name: submit
rows.description: Render a native `<button type="submit">`. Also shows the spinner while the enclosing form action is pending (`useFormStatus`). `onClick` is then ignored.

rows.name: success
rows.description: Green treatment. Mutually exclusive with `danger` (setting both is a type error).

rows.name: suffix
rows.description: Icon component shown after the label (`suffix={ChevronIcon}`), not an element.

rows.name: tabIndex
rows.description: In div mode the button is keyboard-focusable by default; an explicit value wins, except it is forced to `-1` while `disabled` or `loading`. Submit mode passes it through to the native `<button>`, which is focusable anyway.

rows.name: title
rows.description: Native tooltip; passed through.

rows.name: type
rows.description: **Visual variant**, not the HTML `type`. Use `submit` for a submit button.

changelog.text: Surface depth: corners are concentric site-wide with no radius props. `Page` provides depth 0, `Dialog` 1, and `Card`, `CardRow` and `Alert` each provide one level deeper than where they sit; `Popover` (so `Menu` and the `Select` list) provides a fixed 2. Depth 0 is `radius.lg`, 1 is `md`, 2 and deeper is `sm`. `Button`, `Select`, `Card`, `CardRow` and `Alert` follow it; an explicit `Button radius` or `Select surface` still wins. With no `Page`, `Dialog`, `Card`, `CardRow`, `Alert` or `Surface` above it, a component keeps its 0.4.0 look; a bare `Card` (no `Page`) still counts as depth 0 and gives its contents depth 1, so its Buttons and nested Cards change as below.

**Visible changes:**
  - Buttons in a Card default to 8px (they were 16px unless `radius="card"` was set), and Buttons in a Dialog body are 8px.
  - Selects directly on a Page get the page look (16px and the card shadow); in a Card or Dialog they stay 8px. This includes Selects in your own boxes on a Page (a `useModalDialog` modal, a `recipe.card.shell` or `recipe.row` box), because depth cannot see hand-drawn boxes: wrap their contents in `Surface`, or pass `surface="card"`.
  - Without a Page, a bare `Card` counts as depth 0: its Buttons go from 16px to 8px, a Card nested in it steps down, and a `CardRow` in it is 8px.
  - A Card nested in a Card or Dialog steps down (8px, then 4px), and so do its Buttons and Selects; `size="small"` keeps its extra 1px.
  - `CardRow` is 16px on a Page and 8px inside a Card (it was always 16px).
  - Buttons and Selects inside a Popover or Menu are 4px.
The internal `ButtonRadiusContext` is removed; Dialog footer Buttons are unchanged (8px).

`Button` takes a `ref` and `ariaHasPopup`. Its interactive `<div role="button">` now defaults to `tabIndex={0}` so it is reachable by keyboard (`-1` when disabled or loading; an explicit `tabIndex` wins). Its keydown now calls `preventDefault()` on Enter and Space, so Space no longer scrolls the page and Enter opening a menu does not also activate its first item.

Buttons in a `Dialog` footer default to `radius="modal"`; an explicit `radius` still wins. The radius applies to the footer only (a Dialog nested in a footer is unaffected), and `footer={false}`, `''` and `null` render no footer bar.

modules.title: Alert
modules.description: A tinted box for a status message in the page flow, with an optional title, icon and action.
modules.importLine: import { Alert, type AlertProps, type AlertTone } from '@korzun/design/component'
modules.body:
A tinted, bordered box for a status message that sits in the page flow: a tone,
an optional title, body text, an optional icon and an optional action. The
tone's `theme.color.chip[tone]` colours the background, border, title and icon;
the body text uses the normal text colour so a sentence stays readable.

Use something else for: inline field or form failure text (`ErrorMessage`), or a
single status word in a row (`Tag`). An Alert is for a message with weight that
may carry an action.

## Usage

### Choosing a tone

- `warning`: needs attention (overdue, about to expire).
- `danger`: something failed.
- `success`: something finished.
- `info`: neutral news.

`warning` and `danger` render `role="alert"` and are announced the moment they
mount; `success` and `info` render `role="status"` and are announced politely.

### Behaviour

- Corners follow surface depth (see [corners](../corners.md)): 16px on a Page,
  8px in a Card. With no provider the Alert counts as depth 0.
- Its contents, including `action`, sit one level deeper, so a Button in the
  action is already one step smaller than the Alert. Do not pass `radius`.
- There is no default icon per tone; pass `Icon` when you want one.
- Spacing and font sizes come from theme tokens; there is no `style` prop.

## Do / don't

- Do pick the tone by meaning, not by colour.
- Do put the one recovery action in `action`.
- Don't use it for field errors; use `ErrorMessage`.
- Don't mount a `danger` or `warning` Alert for static, always-visible copy:
  it is announced as an alert when it appears.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description:
A `tone`, a short `title` and a sentence of body text. Pick the tone by
meaning: `warning` needs attention.

examples.title: Danger
examples.description:
Something failed. `Icon` takes an icon component and draws it before the title
in the tone's colour; no tone has a default icon. `danger` and `warning` are
announced as `role="alert"`, so mount them when the problem happens.

examples.title: Success
Info
examples.description: Neutral news. `title` is optional: a body alone is fine for a single sentence.

examples.title: With an action, inside a card
examples.description:
`action` holds the one recovery step, usually a Button, on the right; it wraps
under the text when narrow. Inside a Card the Alert's corners and its Button's
corners step down by themselves, so pass no `radius`.

rows.name: children
rows.description: Body text.

rows.name: action
rows.description: Content on the right, usually a Button; wraps under the text when narrow.

rows.name: className
rows.description: Extra class, added last on the root. Override with `'&&'` specificity, never `!important`.

rows.name: Icon
rows.description: Icon shown before the title, in the tone's text colour. There is no default icon per tone.

rows.name: title
rows.description: Short semibold heading above the body.

rows.name: tone
rows.description: Colour family. `warning` and `danger` are announced (`role="alert"`); `success` and `info` are polite (`role="status"`).

changelog.text: Surface depth: corners are concentric site-wide with no radius props. `Page` provides depth 0, `Dialog` 1, and `Card`, `CardRow` and `Alert` each provide one level deeper than where they sit; `Popover` (so `Menu` and the `Select` list) provides a fixed 2. Depth 0 is `radius.lg`, 1 is `md`, 2 and deeper is `sm`. `Button`, `Select`, `Card`, `CardRow` and `Alert` follow it; an explicit `Button radius` or `Select surface` still wins. With no `Page`, `Dialog`, `Card`, `CardRow`, `Alert` or `Surface` above it, a component keeps its 0.4.0 look; a bare `Card` (no `Page`) still counts as depth 0 and gives its contents depth 1, so its Buttons and nested Cards change as below.

New `Alert` (component): a tinted box with a `tone` (`warning`, `danger`, `success`, `info`), optional `title`, `Icon` and `action`, and body text. `danger` and `warning` get `role="alert"`, `success` and `info` get `role="status"`.

modules.title: Stack
modules.description: A vertical column with a themed gap between children.
modules.body:
A vertical flex column with a themed gap between children. Use it to space
things on a screen instead of writing a style file: a form's fields, the
sections of a page, the rows of a list.

Use something else for: a horizontal row (`Inline`), a bordered surface
(`Card`), a divider line between items (`CardDivider`), text styling (`Text`,
`Heading`).

## Usage

### Choosing a gap

Pick `gap` from the theme's `space` scale so spacing is the same everywhere:
`xs` for tight groups, `md` (the default) for most content, `xxl` between
sections. `gap="none"` emits `gap: 0`, for children that supply their own
spacing.

### Behaviour

- `align` is the horizontal (cross-axis) alignment. The default `stretch` makes
  children full width; `start` keeps buttons and tags at their own width.
- `as="ul"` and `as="ol"` also reset the list's margin, padding and bullets.
  Children should be `li` (`<Stack as="li">` works).
- Every other HTML attribute (`id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, event handlers) passes
  through. There is no `style` prop: spacing comes from tokens only.
- Override with `className` at `'&&'` specificity, never `!important`.
- `as="form"` is not offered. Put a `<form>` around the Stack instead.

## Do / don't

- Do nest a Stack in a Stack for sections with different gaps.
- Do use `align="start"` when children (buttons, tags) should not stretch.
- Don't add margins to children to space them; use `gap`.
- Don't reach for `className` to set a gap; use the prop.
- Don't use a Stack for a row; use `Inline`.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description:
A form's fields, spaced by the default `md` gap. Put the `<form>` around the
Stack; children stretch to the full width.

examples.title: Gaps
examples.description:
`gap` takes a key of the theme's `space` scale: `xs` for tight groups, `md`
(the default) for most content, `xxl` between sections. `none` is for
children that bring their own spacing.

examples.title: Alignment
examples.description:
`align` sets the horizontal (cross-axis) placement. The default `stretch` makes
every child full width; use `start` so buttons and tags keep their own width.

examples.title: A semantic list
examples.description:
`as="ul"` renders a list and resets its margin, padding and bullets. Make each
child an `li`; `<Stack as="li">` works.

examples.title: Nested with Inline
examples.description:
Nest Stacks for sections with different gaps, and use `Inline` for each row.
The outer `xxl` gap separates sections; the inner `sm` gap groups a heading
with its content.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The children, laid out top to bottom.

rows.name: align
rows.description: Cross-axis (horizontal) alignment of children; `start`/`end` map to `flex-start`/`flex-end`.

rows.name: as
rows.description: The element to render. `ul`/`ol` also reset list margin, padding and bullets.

rows.name: className
rows.description: Extra class, added last on the root. Override with `'&&'` specificity, never `!important`.

rows.name: gap
rows.description: Space between children, from the theme's `space` tokens, or `'none'`.

rows.name: ref
rows.description: Ref to the root element.

changelog.text: New `Stack` (vertical flex column; `gap`, default `md`), `Inline` (horizontal row; `gap` default `sm`, `justify` including `between`), `Text` (`size`, `tone`, `weight`; unset props inherit), and `Heading` (`level` 1–4), so layout and text are set with props instead of style files.
`truncate` on `Text` and `Heading` clips inside `Stack` (any `align`), `Inline`, and a `Stack` nested in an `Inline`; `Stack` and `Inline` roots have `min-width: 0`.

entries.text: Surface depth: corners are concentric site-wide with no radius props. `Page` provides depth 0, `Dialog` 1, and `Card`, `CardRow` and `Alert` each provide one level deeper than where they sit; `Popover` (so `Menu` and the `Select` list) provides a fixed 2. Depth 0 is `radius.lg`, 1 is `md`, 2 and deeper is `sm`. `Button`, `Select`, `Card`, `CardRow` and `Alert` follow it; an explicit `Button radius` or `Select surface` still wins. With no `Page`, `Dialog`, `Card`, `CardRow`, `Alert` or `Surface` above it, a component keeps its 0.4.0 look; a bare `Card` (no `Page`) still counts as depth 0 and gives its contents depth 1, so its Buttons and nested Cards change as below.

**Visible changes:**
  - Buttons in a Card default to 8px (they were 16px unless `radius="card"` was set), and Buttons in a Dialog body are 8px.
  - Selects directly on a Page get the page look (16px and the card shadow); in a Card or Dialog they stay 8px. This includes Selects in your own boxes on a Page (a `useModalDialog` modal, a `recipe.card.shell` or `recipe.row` box), because depth cannot see hand-drawn boxes: wrap their contents in `Surface`, or pass `surface="card"`.
  - Without a Page, a bare `Card` counts as depth 0: its Buttons go from 16px to 8px, a Card nested in it steps down, and a `CardRow` in it is 8px.
  - A Card nested in a Card or Dialog steps down (8px, then 4px), and so do its Buttons and Selects; `size="small"` keeps its extra 1px.
  - `CardRow` is 16px on a Page and 8px inside a Card (it was always 16px).
  - Buttons and Selects inside a Popover or Menu are 4px.

New `Alert` (component): a tinted box with a `tone` (`warning`, `danger`, `success`, `info`), optional `title`, `Icon` and `action`, and body text. `danger` and `warning` get `role="alert"`, `success` and `info` get `role="status"`.

New `Surface` and `useSurfaceRadius` (component) for hand-made boxes that hold library controls: `Surface` marks its children one level deeper, and `useSurfaceRadius()` returns the radius token for the current depth.
`Select` `surface` gains `'inset'` (`radius.sm`, no shadow), used two or more levels deep.

`theme.space` values are typed as `SpaceValue` (`${number}rem`), so `gap={theme.space.sm}` on `Popover` and `Menu` needs no `as PopoverGap` cast. `Theme['space']` is now typed `${number}rem`, so hand-built Theme objects or mocks with `px` values stop type-checking.
The internal `ButtonRadiusContext` is removed; Dialog footer Buttons are unchanged (8px).

Guidance: AGENTS.md rule 3 now says not to pass `radius` or `surface` by default; `corners.md` replaces "Picking the prop" with "It's automatic"; new docs for `Alert` and `Surface`; `patterns.md` has a status banner recipe; examples no longer set `radius="card"` or `radius="modal"`.

New `Menu` (control): a button that opens a list of actions and links, described as an `items` array (`onClick` for actions, `to` for links; `Icon`, `danger`, `disabled`, `separatorBefore`, `intentProps`). Arrow keys, Home and End move between items, and Escape returns focus to the trigger. `surface` is `solid` or `glass`.

`Menu` trigger props: `ref` is a callback ref, so it attaches to a `<button>`, an `<a>` or a `Button` without a cast; `ariaControls` is set only while the menu is open. Tab from an open menu skips inert, hidden and `tabindex="-1"` elements and stays inside an open `<dialog>`. A disabled link item has no `href`.

Layer stack: popovers and dialogs now close innermost-first. Escape and an outside press only affect the topmost layer, so a popover inside a popover closes one level at a time. **Behaviour change:** a popover beneath an open dialog no longer takes its Escape or closes on a press inside the dialog.
`Popover` `gap` also accepts a `px` or `rem` string (type `PopoverGap`: `` number | `${number}px` | `${number}rem` ``), not only a number of pixels.

`Button` takes a `ref` and `ariaHasPopup`. Its interactive `<div role="button">` now defaults to `tabIndex={0}` so it is reachable by keyboard (`-1` when disabled or loading; an explicit `tabIndex` wins). Its keydown now calls `preventDefault()` on Enter and Space, so Space no longer scrolls the page and Enter opening a menu does not also activate its first item.

`PageActionsMenu` and `PageActionsBar` are rebuilt on `Menu`: arrow keys, Home and End move between actions, and Escape returns focus to the trigger. `PageActionItem` is now `MenuActionItem & { primary?, align? }`: it gains an optional `Icon` (shown in the menus, ignored by the bar's primary Buttons), and `to` is not allowed.
Guidance: AGENTS.md has a new rule 8 (Menus; later rules renumber to 9–11) and `patterns.md` now teaches `Menu`, and `docs/control/menu.md` is new.
New `Dialog` (control): a modal with a title, body and optional footer on a native `<dialog>`; `canDismiss` blocks Escape and backdrop dismissal while busy.
New `ErrorMessage` (component): a `role="alert"` danger-coloured error line that renders nothing when empty.
New `Spinner` (component): a loading indicator that takes the surrounding text colour and size.
`ConfirmModal` is rebuilt on `Dialog`. No API or visual change; it is now named by its title (`aria-labelledby`).
`Popover` renders inside an open `<dialog>` that contains its anchor, so `Select` and `ChipsInput` work in modals.

Buttons in a `Dialog` footer default to `radius="modal"`; an explicit `radius` still wins. The radius applies to the footer only (a Dialog nested in a footer is unaffected), and `footer={false}`, `''` and `null` render no footer bar.
Guidance: AGENTS.md rules 3, 7 and 10 and the imports table, and `patterns.md`, now teach `Dialog`, `ErrorMessage` and `Spinner`; `Dialog` is no longer listed as missing.

New `Stack` (vertical flex column; `gap`, default `md`), `Inline` (horizontal row; `gap` default `sm`, `justify` including `between`), `Text` (`size`, `tone`, `weight`; unset props inherit), and `Heading` (`level` 1–4), so layout and text are set with props instead of style files.
New `fontWeight.regular` (400) token.
`truncate` on `Text` and `Heading` clips inside `Stack` (any `align`), `Inline`, and a `Stack` nested in an `Inline`; `Stack` and `Inline` roots have `min-width: 0`.

AGENTS.md rule 1 now says layout and text go through these props; rule 10 no longer lists Stack, Text and Heading as things to build yourself, and `patterns.md` and `theme.md` now teach the components.
No visual change to existing components.

`Tag` status tones: `success`, `warning` (yellow, stronger fill), `danger`, `info` (brand blue). New `color.warning` and `color.info` solid colours. Status tones report state; label tones name things. No visual change to existing tags.

`Popover`:
  - `side` (`bottom`/`top`) and `align` (`start`/`center`/`end`).
  - Flips when the preferred side has no room.
  - Stays inside the viewport horizontally, unless `matchWidth` (then it lines up with the anchor exactly).
  - On the top side it is anchored by its bottom edge, and it re-measures when its content resizes (`ResizeObserver`), so it stays attached as content grows or shrinks.
  - The provisional first render is transparent rather than hidden, so an `autoFocus` child takes focus.
  - Exposes `data-side`.
  - Escape calls `onClose` unless already handled, without closing a surrounding dialog.
  - Defaults keep the same position when there is room below; `Select` and `ChipsInput` now open upward near the bottom of the viewport.
New types: `PopoverSide`, `PopoverAlign`.

`CardRow` drops its off-scale `12px` corner and takes `radius.lg` from the card shell, since a row sits on the page background. Its stories now render it on the page, not inside a `Card`. **Visible change:** the corners get rounder (12px to 16px).
`Card size="small"` writes its corner as `calc(radius.md + 1px)`: md plus its 1px inset, concentric with its flush `md` children. Same 9px as before, now derived from the token.
New `theme.recipe.row`: the shaded field row (`bg.cardHeader`, `radius.md`, padding `md lg md sm`), for custom rows beside form fields. `Switch`'s horizontal layout now uses it and looks the same.

No runtime changes. Every exported control and component now exports its props type from `/control`, `/component`, and the root:
  - Controls: `BackButtonProps`, `ButtonProps`, `ChipsInputProps`, `ConfirmModalProps`, `FieldListProps`, `NumberInputProps`, `PageActionsBarProps`, `PageActionsMenuProps`, `PageFooterActionsProps`, `PopoverProps`, `SegmentedControlProps`, `SwitchProps`, `TextAreaProps`, `TextInputProps`.
  - Components: `CardProps`, `CardDividerProps`, `CollapsibleSectionProps`, `EmptyStateProps`, `MetadataListProps`, `PageProps`, `ProgressIndicatorProps`, `TagProps`, `ThemeSettingProps`, `TopFadeProps`.
New type exports for prop values: `ButtonTypeValue`, `ButtonRadiusValue`, `ChipColor`, `SegmentedOption`, `SwitchRadiusValue`, `TextInputAction`, `CardDividerAlign`, `PageTypeValue`.
Every prop has a JSDoc comment, so editors and coding agents see the guidance in the `.d.ts`. `useModalDialog` declares its return type.

No code changes. The tarball now includes `AGENTS.md` and `docs/`: guidance for LLM coding agents covering setup, styling rules, the corner-radius-by-depth rule, screen patterns, and one doc per exported control and component. To use it, add `@node_modules/@korzun/design/AGENTS.md` to an app's `CLAUDE.md`.

`Tag` takes a `tone` prop that picks any `theme.color.chip` token (`status`, `author`, `series`, `subject`, `book`, `entryType`, `user`, `rating`, `neutral`) for text, background and border. It defaults to `subject`, so existing tags look the same. The clickable hover now comes from the tone too; with `subject` in light mode it matches the old amber.
New `color.chip.neutral` token: a quiet grey built from each mode's muted text colour (light 0.08 / 0.22 alphas, dark 0.16 / 0.30, matching the other chips in each mode).
`TagTone` type exported from the package root and `/component`.
No code changes. First release published through npm trusted publishing (GitHub Actions OIDC, with provenance); 0.0.1 was published by hand to create the package.
Publish workflow skips `npm publish` when the tagged version is already on the registry, so re-running a release tag is safe.
Theme tokens and light/dark themes; `ThemeProvider` takes an `identity` prop (replaces Bookplate's token coupling).

18 control folders (17 exported, 1 internal helper): `ActionMenuList` (internal), `BackButton`, `Button`, `ChipsInput`, `ConfirmModal`, `DateTimeInput`, `FieldList`, `NumberInput`, `PageActionsBar`, `PageActionsMenu`, `PageFooterActions`, `Popover`, `SegmentedControl`, `Select`, `Switch`, `TextArea`, `TextInput`, `useModalDialog`.

15 component folders (14 exported, `metadata` is internal): `Card`, `CardDivider`, `CardRow`, `CollapsibleSection`, `EmptyState`, `MetaLine`, `Metadata` (internal), `MetadataList`, `NavDesktop`, `NavMobile`, `Page`, `ProgressIndicator`, `Tag`, `ThemeSetting`, `TopFade`; `Page` gains new `documentTitle` and `bottomNav` props.
Icon set, minus brand icons.
Toast: `ToastProvider`, `useToast`.
Hooks: `useMinimizeOnScroll`, `usePullToRefresh`, `isStandalone`.
Subpath exports: `/theme`, `/control`, `/component`, `/icon`, `/toast`, `/hooks`.
Root `ThemeSettingValue` alias for the `ThemeSetting` type.
